name: Their Text, Not Ours
why_it_works: A customer's own words, shown as a real-looking message, borrow trust the brand cannot claim for itself. Starting from the thank-you and rewinding makes viewers curious how the problem got solved, and the viewer sees their own problem in the before.

hook.pattern: Open on the customer's thank-you message on screen with no voiceover, then rewind to how they got there.
examples: "I cried in the parking lot." Here's why.
This text came in at 11pm last night.
"{{customer_quote}}" We had to share this one.

variables.name: customer_quote
variables.description: The customer's real message, short, used with written permission
variables.example: You saved my road trip. Thank you.

variables.name: customer_first_name
variables.description: Customer first name, with permission, or a stand-in like 'One driver'

variables.name: problem
variables.description: The problem they arrived with, in plain words
variables.example: a dashboard full of warning lights two days before a trip

variables.name: what_we_did
variables.description: The specific fix or service, plainly described
variables.example: found a loose sensor wire instead of replacing the whole unit

variables.name: after_state
variables.description: Where they are now, in their terms

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What the viewer gets for acting

craft.technique: Start at the ending, then rewind
craft.notes: The first frame is the payoff in the customer's own words, silent so people read it. Then rewind to the problem. The middle beat shows the work, not the staff smiling. Keep the after concrete: a number, a distance, a date.

do_not: Write a fake review or fake text message
Show a customer's face or name without written permission
Turn the middle beat into a sales pitch
compliance: Only use real customer messages with written permission; keep the permission on file
Dental, chiropractic and med spa: no patient names, faces or health details without a signed HIPAA-compliant authorization, and no promise that the viewer will get the same result
Med spa: any before/after mention needs 'Results vary' on screen
Insurance and real estate: no claim of guaranteed savings, coverage or sale price; include license number where your state requires it
